div.div:
A "properly configured seccomp profile" is a
whitelist that blocks any system call the
application doesn't absolutely need to function.

div.div:
Mandatory Access Control (MAC) systems in the kernel.
They provide a layer of security beyond standard file permissions (like chmod 777).
A policy might state: "The Nginx process can only read files in /var/www/html and only write to /var/log/nginx."

div.div:
The kernel maps UID 0 inside the container to a high, unprivileged UID outside on the host.
If an attacker successfully breaks out of the container, they suddenly find themselves as a
powerless user on the host machine, unable to do any damage.
